summary: Comprehensive testing of Hi DMC website completed. All backend APIs (12/12 tests passed) and frontend features working correctly. Homepage loads with all sections, destination detail pages work properly, contact form submission successful, search functionality works, and all navigation is functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/ - Root endpoint returns 'Hi DMC API'
Backend: GET /api/destinations - Returns 12 destinations including India
Backend: GET /api/destinations/trending - Returns 6 trending destinations
Backend: GET /api/destinations/region/Europe - Region filtering works
Backend: GET /api/destinations/detail/India - Returns rich detail with key_experiences, key_destinations_within, tour_packages
Backend: GET /api/destinations/detail/Greece - Returns detail: null (as expected)
Backend: GET /api/destinations/detail/NonExistent - Returns 404
Backend: POST /api/inquiries - Creates inquiry successfully
Backend: GET /api/stats - Returns correct statistics
Frontend: Navbar has 5 links (Destinations, Services, Technology, About, Contact) + Sign In (outlined) + Request a Demo (solid teal)
Frontend: Hero section has 'Request a Demo' and 'Our Technology' buttons
Frontend: Stats section displays with animated numbers (15+ Years Experience)
Frontend: TrendingDestinations shows 6 unique clickable cards with Links to /destination/:name
Frontend: Services section has statistical banners (2,500+, 500K+, 200+, 10K+)
Frontend: OurTechnology section has dark background (rgb(13, 27, 42)) with Trip Builder content and 6 benefits
Frontend: Accreditations section has dark strip with text-based logos (IATA, Incredible India, Dubai Tourism, PATA, TAAI, Visit Iceland)
Frontend: GlobalDestinations heading is 'Explore Our Destinations' with search input
Frontend: Search in GlobalDestinations filters destinations by name
Frontend: Testimonials section has NO star ratings (as expected)
Frontend: ContactCTA form has labeled fields (Full Name, Company Name, Email, Phone, Message)
Frontend: Contact form submission works - shows 'Thank You' success message
Frontend: Clicking destination card navigates to /destination/:name
Frontend: India destination detail page has hero, key facts, experiences, destinations within, tour packages, CTA
Frontend: Greece destination detail page shows basic info without detail sections (detail: null)
seed_data_creation: None - using existing seeded data (12 destinations, India with rich detail)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from the latest changes are working correctly: 1) Navbar cleaned up with 5 links + Sign In + Request Demo buttons, 2) OurTechnology section has dark theme with Trip Builder content, 3) Services section has stat banners, 4) Accreditations has dark strip with text logos, 5) ContactCTA form has labeled fields, 6) Testimonials has no stars, 7) No duplicate destinations, 8) GlobalDestinations renamed with search, 9) Destination cards are clickable Links, 10) India detail page has all rich content sections.
